name: re-toolkit
description: Build step for the Frida agents in scripts/ - bundles each entry point (and its import of scripts/_lib.js) into a single self-contained file under dist/, which is what Frida and the Python drivers in src/retk/ actually load.

scripts.build: npm run build:table-a && npm run build:table-b && npm run build:probe && npm run build:trace-lookup && npm run build:list-exports && npm run build:verify && npm run build:snapshot
